coordinate_system: Y-up, -Z forward; one exported unit is one meter

asset_contract.title: Wing sail
asset_contract.summary: A cleat on the hull and three spars (the middle one the boom) splaying down and out 3.9 m, teal cloth between them trimmed in canvas, brass points. Outboard is +X: starboard wings unturned, port wings turned half round. Pivot on the chine node it hangs from. Ship part hull.wing_sail (node part).
asset_contract.placement: Pivot at the frame node the part hangs on (part pivot offset zero).
asset_contract.materials: Sail_Wood, Sail_Brass, Sail_Iron, Sail_Sail, Sail_Trim, Sail_Rope; ShipDesignsAssetBuilder swaps each for the shared ship material (M_ShipHull, M_ShipEngine, M_ShipIron, M_ShipSail, M_ShipCanvas, M_ShipDeck).
asset_contract.footprint_blocks: Blocks out to x 4 and down to y -4, z -1..1; not solid.
asset_contract.movable_parts: None yet: the cloth is to sway in its material (ART_DIRECTION.md, Motion and life).
